limits: Checks canonical spelling and the presence of both supplied lines through the real finish CLI. It cannot establish that the provenance is true, that this is fix-type work, that a caller uses the optional flag, or that the text was published to an issue/PR. No required missing-provenance gate is claimed.

cases.name: invalid
cases.why: Both supplied lines exist but use noncanonical values; readability alone must not pass.

cases.name: invalid-origin
cases.why: Only Origin is noncanonical; a valid missed answer cannot hide it.

cases.name: invalid-missed
cases.why: Only Missed because is noncanonical; a valid origin cannot hide it.

cases.name: missing
cases.why: The supplied closing text omits Missed because; one line is not two.

cases.name: conflicting
cases.why: Two different Origin answers cannot identify one origin.

cases.name: valid
cases.why: Both supplied lines have canonical values, distinguishing refusal from validation.

cases.name: unknown-contract
cases.why: The fixture package has no canonical contract; values cannot be checked.

anchors.why: CONSTRUCTED: all existing finish checks and contract/input unreadability stay intact, but a readable closing file is mistaken for valid canonical fields. It misses each BAD case and accepts the GOOD case while preserving UNKNOWN.
